messages:
alex: Heads-up — I'm proposing we retrofit a soft rate-limiter on /v1/embeddings. Noisy tenants keep sending huge mixed-dim batches and we're seeing backend OOMs + 413s.

tara: +1 on protecting runtime. Do you mean a global token-based limiter or per-tenant? :thinking_face:

alex: Per-tenant preferred. Also want an early preflight fast-fail path in the ingress to avoid queuing on the runtime. soft vs hard cap debate.

mohan: Important to preserve UX: for soft limits we can return a 202 + estimate and accept async processing? That complicates client SDKs.

jess: Can we instead return a structured error with hint to split? e.g. `\{\"code\":\"EMBED_OVERSIZE\", \"hint\":\"split into <= 10k tokens or use split=true\"\}`

alex: I like structured error. For soft-limit we can offer `x-embed-suggest-split: true` header + console telemetry showing suggested split counts.

tara: Console UX: we should surface per-tenant headroom + a little green/yellow/red bar and a button to request higher soft cap. Ops owns approvals.

mohan: Runtime note: mixed-dim batches are the killer. If dims vary across items in a batch we currently fallback to large padding which spikes mem. Suggest additive rules: preflight rejects mixed dims above 10 items or auto-split.

alex: Proposed ingress rule snippet:
```
route: /v1/embeddings
policy:
  per_tenant_soft_limit: 2000_items_per_min
  mixed_dim_threshold: 10
  oversize_bytes: 10MB
  fallback: split_by_dim | reject_with_hint
```

jess: Also want telemetry events: `embed.preflight.reject` with tags {reason, tenant_id, dims, items, bytes}. Console dashboard can show top reject reasons per hour.

deploy-bot: deploy initiated: embeds-ingress/limit-retrofit canary -> us-west-2

alex: Canary deployed. Looking for quick feedback from load tests for next 24h. If we see false positives we relax soft limit or bump thresholds.

tara: Note: need docs for SDKs (auto-split flag, parse EMED_OVERSIZE) and an in-console explanation of the suggested split algorithm.

mohan: Load test comment: if split fallback is used often, we should surface `estimated_token_cost` in the telemetry so Optimize can recommend quantization/batching changes.

jess: Agreed. Also add a console alert when a tenant crosses >50% soft headroom for 3 windows in a row.

alex: TL;DR: canary live, policy above, structured error + header, telemetry events. Ops review flow for cap increases. Will iterate on thresholds after 24h.

jess: acknowledged. I'll draft SDK PR and console mockups.

mohan: I'll wire telemetry and add histogram for `preflight_latency_ms`. Keep an eye on 413 spikes.

alex: thanks team :thumbsup:
